note: Re-recording of scenario-prevention-resources from before its premise. The converted record started with a prevention shield of two already in force on B, a resource (615.7) the projection does not state, so no engine could construct its start. Here a Hallowed Healer's ability is activated in the record, targeting B: its resolution creates the shield. Spear Spewer then deals 1 damage to each player (one point of the shield prevents B's, 615.6, 615.7), Shock deals 2 to B (the last point prevents one), and Shock deals 2 to Aegis Turtle, which with a +1/+1 counter (1/6) and four damage marked is destroyed (704.5g). A second Healer is then activated legally, creating a distinct shield (615.7), and the first Healer's re-activation is refused: it is tapped, so its {T} cost cannot be paid (107.5, 118.3, 601.2h). Position: turn 7, A's fourth turn (spec 2.4), precombat main phase, empty stack; stipulated final values (spec 2.4): two red mana in A's pool, the Turtle's counter and its four damage. Every permanent has been under its controller's control since the turn began.

transitions.note: A activates the first Healer's ability (602.2), paying its cost by tapping it ({T}, 107.5; 602.2b), targeting B. Both pass (implied) and it resolves: the next 2 damage that would be dealt to B this turn is prevented (615.7: a shield of two). Nothing of the shield is in the projection; its effects are.
Spear Spewer's ability resolves after the implied passes: 1 damage to each player (120.3a); the shield prevents B's and one point remains (615.6, 615.7); A loses 1 life.
Shock at B, paid from the pool (601.2h). The shield's last point prevents one of the two damage (615.7); B loses 1 life; the shield is used up.
Shock at the Turtle: with its +1/+1 counter it is 1/6 (122.1a); four damage marked plus two is lethal (704.5g) and it is destroyed as a state-based action before A receives priority (704.3).

A activates the second Healer the same way, targeting B: a new, distinct shield of two for B this turn (615.7), the first one having been used up. It expires at the cleanup step with the turn's other 'this turn' effects (514.2), which the record does not reach.

The first Healer is tapped: a tapped permanent cannot be tapped again to pay {T} (107.5, 118.3), so the cost is unpayable (601.2h through 602.2b), the activation is refused and nothing changes (733.1).
